title: Quietly Smoky Korean Pretzels Onigiri
description: A smoky, pillowy, monsoon Korean dish featuring pretzels and nigiri-shaping, macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, inspired by Jeju cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together Korean chili flakes, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and smoked sea salt.
Add the pretzels to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated with the smoky mixture.
Spread the pretzels on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Allow the pretzels to cool completely.
Cut the toasted nori sheets into small pieces and set aside.
To assemble the onigiri, lay a small handful of pretzels on a flat surface and shape into a triangle.
Place a small piece of nori in the center of the pretzel triangle.
Top the nori with a few slices of scallion and a sprinkle of black sesame seeds.
Fold the pretzel triangle over the filling to form a triangle shape, and press the edges together to seal.
